subject: Observability pricing: slab vs usage tiers — clarifying tradeoffs
messages:
From: Sarah Delgado <sarah.delgado@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Observability addon pricing — some questions

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the proposal. We're evaluating two internal models for the observability add-on: a slab (annual committed tiers for retention + tracing) and a strictly metered (per-GB/day ingest + per-100M traces). Before we present to finance, could you confirm: 1) how credits or overage smoothing work if we under/over-shoot the slab; 2) whether seatless dashboard access can be carved out for our analytics team without paying full-seat licensing; 3) what the pilot pricing looks like for the first 90 days (we want a low-friction POC).

Also attached is our procurement checklist — procurement asked for an amortized example over 12 months. Can you send a simple cost comparison (slab vs metered) reflecting our expected 4 TB/mo ingest and 15M spans/day sample rate?

Best,
Sarah
Director of Platform Engineering
Acme Corp
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Delgado <sarah.delgado@acme-corp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability addon pricing — some questions

Sarah —

Appreciate the clear asks. High level answers up front, followed by an attached spreadsheet with line-item math:

1) Smoothing & overage: slabs are annual and include a 10% buffer for month-to-month variability; if you exceed committed volume we charge overage at the metered rate but cap monthly overages to 20% of committed volume before automatic tier upgrade triggers. We do a quarterly reconciliation and offer one-time rollover credits (up to 15% of unused) if you renew.

2) Seatless dashboards: we can offer a seatless display license for read-only dashboards at 25% of a full seat per dashboard instance, or a per-dashboard bundle for unlimited read-only viewers that is priced based on number of dashboards (example on sheet).

3) Pilot: 90-day POC — we typically do 50% off list for the first 90 days on both slab and metered; if you convert to annual slab within 30 days after pilot end we credit the pilot spend against the first quarter.

I'll attach the cost comparison populated with your numbers (4 TB/mo, 15M spans/day with a 10% sampling uplift). Laura and Karthik are looped for legal/SOW and technical fit.

Next step: would you like a short walkthrough of the attached workbook tomorrow?

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-observability-pricing-v3.xlsx
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Delgado <sarah.delgado@acme-corp.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability addon pricing — some questions

Sarah —

Quick note from legal/procurement side:

- Rollover credits and reconciliation language will be included in the SOW; we can make the 15% unused rollover explicit.
- For slab customers we can add a clause for a one-time tier down in year 2 if actual ingest is consistently 30% below committed for two consecutive quarters.
- Pilot credits: we will need a signed POC SOW (short-form) that references the trial credit and conversion credit mechanics.

Irene, can you confirm the billing cadence options (monthly invoice vs quarterly drawdown) and whether we can show amortized monthly pricing in the SOW?

Thanks,
Laura
Head of Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Sarah Delgado <sarah.delgado@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability addon pricing — some questions

Sarah / team —

Billing options: we support monthly invoicing (with month-to-month reconciliation), and an annual prepay that amortizes across 12 monthly invoices for accounting. For slab we recommend annual commitment with monthly invoices (to keep finance happy while preserving committed pricing). We can present an amortized table in the SOW; I'll include both prepay and amortized annual views.

On the seatless dashboard option: the per-dashboard bundle we propose is priced per 10 dashboards block at $900/month equivalent when amortized against an annual commit — details in workbook.

Forwarding the sample SOW template as a stub (attached).

Irene
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample-sow-retain-tracing.docx
From: Sarah Delgado <sarah.delgado@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@acme-corp.com, John Hill <john.hill@brightline.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability addon pricing — some questions

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups before our procurement review: 1) can you show a modeled example where we start with a metered approach for 6 months then convert to slab at a 12% discount to list (to reflect conversion incentive)? 2) We need an explicit callout around sample rates — if we change sampling policies mid-year, does that count as usage change for reconciliation?

Procurement would also like an explicit example invoice for month 1 of the POC (with pilot credit applied). If you can send that by EOD Thursday we can get on the procurement calendar next week.

Appreciate the speed — Sarah
